attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-node RabbitMQ cluster (node1/node2/node3, AlmaLinux 9) with AMQP over TLS enforced by a cluster-dedicated CA. Server certs for each node (SAN=nodename+IP+localhost) and a client cert were issued from a self-created "RabbitMQ Cluster CA". rabbitmq.conf disables plaintext AMQP (listeners.tcp=none), serves AMQP only on 5671/TLS with ssl_options.verify=verify_peer and fail_if_no_peer_cert=true so only clients presenting a CA-issued cert can connect (verified: valid client cert accepted, no-cert and rogue self-signed cert both rejected with TLS alerts). The management UI (15672) is bound to each node's own cluster IP and firewalled via firewalld rich rules to the 10.100.48.0/24 cluster subnet only (confirmed reachable node-to-node, and inaccessible outside that scope by firewall policy). All three nodes are clustered (rabbitmqctl cluster_status shows all Running/Disc nodes) and an end-to-end mTLS AMQP publish/consume test succeeded on every node. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol for all three nodes: captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy proof, issued a native `reboot` whose ack returned before disconnect, polled until each node was reachable again, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified rabbitmq-server became active with full 3/3 cluster quorum and working mTLS AMQP before moving to the next node.
